status: NEW (v4 R11 governs only the Dais-owned render; the live netlify function that ALSO emits leaderboard is left unreconciled and serves un-enriched, gameable data)
description: v4 R11 (behavioral-spec.md:73-76) assigns leaderboard production to the Dais-owned dashboard-sync render that writes the served apps/landing/public/dashboard.json, and forbids Anicca from writing that file. But there is a SECOND, already-deployed producer of leaderboard that v4 never mentions or reconciles: the landing-repo netlify function apps/landing/netlify/functions/dashboard-sync.js, which at line 14 returns JSON.stringify(aggregate(rows)) directly from the Supabase instances rows — WITHOUT any enrichOnChain step. That public function endpoint therefore serves a leaderboard built from RAW SELF-REPORTED net_worth_usd/revenue_mo_usd (telemetry-aggregate.js:2-3,10 sort by self-reported net_worth_usd), i.e. exactly the gameable, un-verified figures INV-NOFAKE (behavioral-spec.md:98-101) promises never to rank. The spec leaves two leaderboard code paths coexisting (one enriched+un-buyable, one raw+self-reported) with no statement that the netlify function is removed, repurposed to call enrichOnChain, or otherwise prevented from exposing un-verified rankings. Separately, revenue_by_source is signed (R10:69), typed (R9:68) and carried (R1:38), and the design renders it in the per-agent drill-down (design:78), but R6's UI render contract (behavioral-spec.md:56-60) never specifies rendering it or labelling its self-reported provenance — a signed-but-self-asserted money breakdown can reach the UI unlabelled.

evidence.snippet: body: JSON.stringify(aggregate(Array.isArray(rows) ? rows : [])),  // aggregate() of raw Supabase rows, NO enrichOnChain

crossEvidence.note: aggregate sums and ranks raw self-reported net_worth_usd/revenue_mo_usd; without enrichOnChain this endpoint serves un-verified, buyable rankings
R6 render contract omits revenue_by_source and its self-reported provenance label

fix: State explicitly what happens to the netlify dashboard-sync.js function: either remove it, or have it run enrichOnChain before aggregate so it cannot serve un-verified rankings; confirm a single source of the enriched leaderboard. Add revenue_by_source (with a self-reported indicator) to the R6 render contract.
